title: Finite extension polynomial resource contract
objective: Specify and validate a storage-neutral generated-resource contract for dense univariate polynomials over finite extension fields, including exact Sage semantics, one bulk coordinate boundary, differential oracles, and measured scalar-boundary costs without implementing shared FFI
references: SageMath finite field and polynomial semantics
FLINT fq, fq_nmod, and fq_default APIs

handoff.summary: Defines the strict storage-neutral contract for generated finite-extension FqContext, FqElement, and FqPolynomial resources without inventing a fake resource implementation. It pins exact context identity, deterministic modulus metadata, low-to-high polynomial and power-basis coordinate ordering, canonical residues, trailing-zero normalization, and one synchronous bulk construction/export callback. CPython, Sage.js, and SageMath agree on the tested parent identity, incompatibility, coefficient, modulus, and zero semantics. For a 1,000-coefficient GF(3^2) polynomial, current Sage.js scalar construction measured about 975 ms and SagePack load about 1,032 ms, while validating the complete 2,000-coordinate table and calling one sentinel callback measured about 5 ms; the benchmark explicitly labels that last number as protocol overhead only, not FFI resource performance.
risks: This lane intentionally specifies but does not implement FqContext, FqElement, or FqPolynomial declarations, generated adapters, lifecycle, public wiring, or WASM lowering.
Power-basis coordinates are an interchange boundary, not canonical live storage; an integration that retains or exposes the host table would recreate the representation coupling this design avoids.
Word-sized characteristics can use packed unsigned residues, but larger characteristics need a compiler-owned exact-integer coordinate region without changing the contract.

The full pnpm test:native command ran for about 436 seconds and reached test/native-kernel.cjs, then failed an inherited foreign-header cache assertion: it observed packages/flint/include/sagejs/fmpq_matrix_ffi.h where the test expected its temporary override-prefix copy. Coordinator commit 8898b83 addresses that shared receipt failure; no claimed source in this lane was involved.
next_steps: Declare generated owned context, element, and polynomial resources with an acyclic context ownership graph and deterministic close/finalizer behavior.
Implement one bulk power-basis construction/export adapter over FLINT fq_default, selecting fq_nmod or fq storage internally without exposing that choice to public mathematics.
Wire the public GF(p^n)[x] parent to resource-to-resource arithmetic and use bulk export only for explicit coefficients, formatting, and SagePack boundaries.
Add sanitizer-backed context/element/polynomial lifetime schedules and prove a credible WASM lowering before replacing the legacy opaque backend.
